text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty HIGH alert fired — gateway-prod error rate > 6% (5xx) over 3m. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embed. Pager: maya (on-call). Runbook: gateway-5xx.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created PD-8321 — severity: high. Escalation: maya -> timeout 2m before auto-escalate. See: https://pagerduty.example/PD-8321

maya: ack'd PD and taking it. pulling logs + kvcache metrics now.

ben: seeing a big spike from eu-west LB, mostly 502 and some 504. @maya do PD tags include region and cluster?

maya: PD tags: region=eu-west1 cluster=gateway-2. running `kubectl -n prod logs deploy/gateway-2 --since=5m` to confirm.

tom: noticing autoscale flapping on gateway-2 around 22:12 UTC, also last deploy ~22:11. canary fallback may be contributing.

incident-bot: Auto-suppress duplicate alerts for matching signature for 10m. Notifying next handover in 8m.

maya: logs show repeated `upstream reset by peer` and `context deadline exceeded` from ingress sidecars. temporarily bumping ingress retries to 3 -> 6. /cc @liam :eyes:

liam: on infra. checking NLB health and backend registration tables now. seeing backend instance drain events starting 22:12:05 — likely rolling events from kube. grabbing ASG/deploy timeline.

ben: customer impact: two enterprise customers reported generation timeouts from EU region. CS notified with an interim message. ticket INC-9447 created.

maya: can we failover traffic to gateway-1? what's the risk to cache warmup and latency if we shift weights?

liam: we can shift ~30% quickly to gateway-1 via traffic weight adjustment, doing gradual splay to avoid cache-stampede. command I'm using: `kubectl patch svc gateway --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/traffic/0/weight","value":70}]'` (will splay +10% every 30s).

tom: started weight splay at 22:14:05 UTC (+10% every 30s). watching 5xx and p50/p95.

pagerduty-bot: maya acknowledged PD-8321 at 22:14:10 UTC.

maya: after splay, 5xx rate dropped from ~6.8% -> 1.1% in the 3m window. rolling back my ingress retry bump to avoid extra retries. keeping close watch for 10m. :thumbsup:

ben: updated CS: partial degradation for EU customers; mitigation in progress. ask CS to hold on broader notification until stable. post-incident review scheduled.

maya: handing to night SRE @liam for post-incident cleanup and RCA. marking PD-8321 state: under investigation -> mitigated. will keep incident open for RCA notes.
